description: Fix issue-288: model-setting UI paths that select a model without a reasoning variant now express the delete intent via `variant: null`, so a stale agent.variant can never survive the workflow-profile variables merge or reach the runner's model-id composition. Web-local payload fix on three handlers; server merge contract and runner composition are confirmed/locked, not altered.

tasks.title: Lock workflow-profile variables null-delete contract for agent.variant and confirm runner variant-absent composition
tasks.description: No server or runner production code change. Confirm and (if a gap exists) extend `packages/server` `VariableBundleSpecs.cs` so the null-delete / omitted-preserve merge semantics are locked specifically for the `vars.agent.variant` leaf shape the Web fix now depends on. Confirm the runner `session-strategies` / `model-resolution` specs already cover the variant-absent composition path (bare model id, no `/<variant>` suffix).
acceptanceCriteria: `VariableBundleSpecs.cs` has a green case asserting that a PATCH overlay setting `vars.agent.variant = null` over a base with `agent.variant = "high"` yields a merged result with NO `agent.variant` key.

`VariableBundleSpecs.cs` has a green case asserting that a PATCH overlay setting `vars.agent.model` while OMITTING `variant`, over a base with `agent.variant = "high"`, preserves `agent.variant = "high"` unchanged.
`VariableBundleSpecs.cs` has a green case asserting that a `variant: null` overlay over a base with no `agent.variant` keeps the result free of any `agent.variant` key (no null value stored).

Runner model-resolution / session-strategies spec is verified green for: when `agent.variant` is absent/empty/undefined, `composeRequestedModel` returns a bare `model` with no variant field and no suffix appended; when `agent.variant = "high"`, it returns `model/high`.
`npm test` (server) and runner `npm test` pass; no production source in `packages/server` or `packages/runner` is modified.
tasks.output: Extended/verified spec cases in `packages/server` VariableBundleSpecs.cs covering agent.variant null-leaf deletion + omitted-preserve; recorded confirmation that runner session-strategies specs already cover variant-absent composition. All relevant test suites green.
tasks.notes: If existing VariableBundleSpecs.cs already covers the agent.variant null-leaf shape, this task resolves to confirmation (no new code) — the deliverable is the locked contract assurance, not new production code. Per design Decision 4 and the proposal, server/runner production code MUST NOT change; this fix relies on the existing contract.

tasks.title: Clear stale variant in IssueModelSelector on model-only selection (issue default + issue stage scope)
tasks.description: In `packages/web/src/features/select-issue-model/ui/IssueModelSelector.tsx`, add `variant: null` to the PATCH value object emitted by `handleSelect` (issue default, ~line 219) and by `handleSetStageModel` (issue stage scope, ~line 272), so selecting a model without a variant chip deletes any previously stored issue/stage `agent.variant`. Update `IssueModelSelector.test.tsx`: flip the existing 'selects the default variant (no variant)' assertion that currently expects the buggy `{ type, model }` payload to now expect `variant: null`, and add a stage-scoped variant-clearing case.
acceptanceCriteria: `handleSelect` calls `patchIssueWorkflowDefinitionVar` with `vars.agent = { type: 'opencode', model, variant: null }` (variant key present and null, not omitted).
`handleSetStageModel` issues the stage-scoped PATCH with `stages.<stage>.vars.agent` containing `variant: null` alongside `type` and `model`.
Stage-scoped delete only clears the targeted stage's variant; a sibling stage's `agent.variant` is preserved unchanged (covered by a test with two stages both carrying a variant).

`IssueModelSelector.test.tsx` is green and asserts: (a) issue default no-variant select carries `variant: null`; (b) issue stage no-variant select carries stage-scoped `variant: null`; (c) idempotent delete when no variant was previously stored still sends `variant: null`.
`npm run typecheck -w packages/web` passes and `npm run test:run -w packages/web` passes.
tasks.output: Modified `packages/web/src/features/select-issue-model/ui/IssueModelSelector.tsx` (handleSelect + handleSetStageModel emit variant: null) and updated `IssueModelSelector.test.tsx` with flipped + new regression cases; web typecheck and test:run green.
tasks.notes: handleSelect and handleSetStageModel are the same component/file/test file and apply the identical `variant: null` pattern at two scopes — they are ONE functional unit (issue-level model selection) and must not be split into separate tasks. The local state for stage model already drops the variant; only the persisted PATCH payload is wrong.

tasks.title: Clear stale project default variant on AiSettingsSection same-row re-click
tasks.description: In `packages/web/src/pages/settings/ui/AiSettingsSection.tsx` `handleSetOpencodeModel` (~line 78), remove the `if (modelId === storedDefaultModel) return` short-circuit so the mutation always fires with `{ model, variant: null }` whenever a model row is chosen, clearing any stale project default variant. Add a regression case to `AiSettingsSection.test.tsx` for re-clicking the already-selected model row.
acceptanceCriteria: `handleSetOpencodeModel` no longer early-returns when `modelId === storedDefaultModel`; the `setOpencodeModel.mutate({ model, variant: null })` call always fires on a model-row click.
Clicking the already-selected default model row fires the mutation with `{ model, variant: null }` (clears a stale default variant instead of no-op'ing).
Selecting a different default model row fires the mutation with `{ model: <new>, variant: null }`.
`AiSettingsSection.test.tsx` is green with a new case asserting the same-row re-click clears the variant, and the existing different-row selection case still clears the variant.
`npm run typecheck -w packages/web` passes and `npm run test:run -w packages/web` passes.
tasks.output: Modified `packages/web/src/pages/settings/ui/AiSettingsSection.tsx` (guard removed, variant: null always sent on row click) and updated `AiSettingsSection.test.tsx` with the same-row re-click regression case; web typecheck and test:run green.
tasks.notes: Different component/file/scope from T-002 (project default via AiSettingsSection vs issue override via IssueModelSelector), so it is a separate functional task. The extra idempotent PATCH on same-row click is an accepted trade-off (design Decision 3 / Risks) — cheaper and less brittle than a conditional branch that could re-introduce the bug class.
